content: {"episode_id":"ep-05047","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication. The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic episodes of giddiness to guide further management."}
